posts.text: 1w A customer pays. Their card is charged. But the order never reaches fulfillment. No pick ticket. No shipment. Then the support ticket arrives, and someone has to rebuild the order or issue a refund. This is rarely a warehouse problem. It is usually a blast-radius problem. When multiple stores share one account-level webhook endpoint and event scope, a configuration change for one store can interrupt order events for all of them. The better pattern is store-level isolation: • one endpoint per store • one event scope per store • one clear owner per store
